purpose: Lightweight source of truth for public portfolio module labels, repository URLs, section anchors, operating phases, audiences, proof types, and packaging decisions.

packagingPolicy.currentDecision: Do not add another public portfolio module unless the existing landing page, catalog, journey route, artifact library, or source repository cannot explain the capability clearly enough.
packagingPolicy.preferredPath: Strengthen existing proof paths before creating new repositories or landing-page lanes.

deferredModuleIdeas.title: AI Governance Portfolio Register
deferredModuleIdeas.currentHome: AI idea to governed artifact lifecycle route plus AI opportunity and artifact governance repositories
deferredModuleIdeas.decision: Defer as a standalone module until it fills a proof gap that the current AI governance route cannot cover.

deferredModuleIdeas.title: Partner Ecosystem Governance Kit
deferredModuleIdeas.currentHome: Partner ecosystem governance route plus Operating Patterns artifact source
deferredModuleIdeas.decision: Keep as an artifact/source pattern unless it needs a separate runnable package for evaluation.

packagingPolicy.acceptanceCheck: A new module should reduce reviewer confusion, not create another destination readers must inspect before they understand the portfolio.
